items.title: 3 Reasons TSCO is Risky and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
items.summary: What a brutal six months it’s been for Tractor Supply. The stock has dropped 31.8% and now trades at $31.37, rattling many shareholders. This was partly due to its softer quarterly results and may have investors wondering how to approach the situation.

items.title: Tractor Supply inaugurates $200M distribution facility in Idaho
items.summary: Tractor Supply will soon begin shipping goods to 123 stores from a new distribution center in Idaho. The post Tractor Supply inaugurates $200M distribution facility in Idaho appeared first on FreightWaves.

items.title: How Much Further Could Lowe's Stock Fall With Its DIY Shoppers Holding Back?
items.summary: Lowe's Companies (LOW) stock trades near $191, its lowest price of the past year and about 33% below its 52-week high. Over the trailing twelve months, it lost 25.9%, while the S&P 500 returned 18.5% with dividends reinvested. No market crash did this. So how much further could it fall if one arrives.

items.title: Is Lowe's Cheap Because Nobody Noticed Its Growth?
items.summary: Lowe's Companies (LOW) grew revenue faster over the past twelve months than any of the five companies it is ranked against. It is also the cheapest of them on earnings. That combination normally means the market has missed something. Here it looks more like the market is reading the growth differently than the rank does.

items.title: Tractor Supply (TSCO) Stock May Trade At A 17% Discount On Cash Flow
items.summary: Tractor Supply has seen its share price fall to US$33.03 after a series of weak returns, and that slide puts the spotlight squarely on whether the current valuation is still supported by the cash the business can generate. With the stock down sharply over the past year, the key issue is whether the cash flow outlook has changed enough to justify where the market has now settled. items.title: Is Tractor Supply (TSCO) Cheap As Weaker Guidance Clouds Its Valuation?
items.summary: Tractor Supply (TSCO) is back in focus after underwhelming second quarter results, softer comparable store sales, and a lowered full year earnings outlook. items.title: 1 S&P 500 Stock Worth Your Attention and 2 We Avoid
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is often seen as a benchmark for strong businesses, but that doesn’t mean every stock is worth owning. Some companies face significant challenges, whether it’s stagnating growth, heavy debt, or disruptive new competitors.
